title: peer_fetch: Limited size-exceeded mapped to Network not SizeExceeded
description: In fetch_with_https_client (and fetch_peer_blob_from_url), when a peer body exceeds expected_size+1, Limited::collect() returns Err(LengthLimitError) which is mapped to FetchBlobError::Network. The SizeExceeded variant is only reachable from the post-collect length check, which can never fire because Limited stops the stream first. Callers in lib.rs map Network to 502 and SizeExceeded to 500; a misbehaving peer body silently appears as 'peer unavailable'. Fix: downcast_ref::<LengthLimitError>() to classify correctly.
